title: Inference decision quickmap — seller pocket pilot (sketch)
content:
Purpose:
A one-page rapid decision map for sellers running pilot conversations with engineering/platform teams. Helps qualify the ideal deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private) and pre-bakes fallback and canary checks so SEs can move faster during discovery. This is intentionally compact for Slack/DM or printed as a pocket reference.

TL;DR (elevator):
- Ask the 6 qualification signals below.
- If >3 constraints are must-have (data residency, on-prem, SLA, sustained qps), recommend Dedicated or Private.
- For latency-sensitive UIs with moderate volume recommend Hosted + regional routing + KV caching first, escalate to Dedicated if 95th latency > target after caching/configs.

Top 6 qualification questions (script bullets):
1) Data residency & compliance: "Does data need to stay in your VPC or on-prem?" (Yes -> Private; partial -> Dedicated with VPC peering)
2) Latency target: "What 95th/99th tail latency do you need for user flows?" (<=200ms -> evaluate model size, KV cache, RD)
3) Predictable throughput: "Do you have steady sustained qps or spiky bursts?" (sustained high -> Dedicated reserve)
4) Cost sensitivity: "Is per-token cost a gating factor for POC?" (Yes -> Optimize configs + quantized model variants)
5) Security/Audit needs: "Will you require HSM/KMS or SOC/ISO logs?" (Yes -> Private or Enterprise Dedicated)
6) Integration surface: "Will you call the LLM from client browsers or server only?" (client -> Hosted + tokenization / proxy patterns)

Micro-decision matrix (seller shorthand):
- Axis: Cost predictability (low->high) vs Latency SLAs (lenient->strict).
- Quick rule: Top-right (High predictability, strict latency) -> Dedicated w/ reserved capacity and local routing.
- Bottom-left (Low predictability, lenient latency) -> Hosted pay-as-you-go.
- Middle path -> Hosted with routing polices + Optimize suggestions, schedule canary for Dedicated if growth occurs.

Fallback recipes (copy-paste snippets for SEs):
- If model falls over or queueing: "Enable fallback route to smaller quantized variant + auto-scale burst (policy 'burst-allow') — scripts: set route fallback: model: rl-medium-q4 -> rl-small-q4"
- If latency spikes at tail: "Enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts and enable dynamic batching window=4ms; check kernel profile in runtime console"
- If cost runaways: "Apply per-route token quota and recommend streaming with truncated context; schedule Optimize eval"

Demo / pilot kickoff script (5–7 minute starter):
0) Intent: 1-sentence problem recap.
1) Walk model responses live for 3 prompts (show latency numbers).
2) Flip to console view: show per-token cost, route config, and fallback set.
3) Propose next steps: 2-week pilot with X reserved hours on Dedicated trial OR hosted with target SLOs + canary.

SE quick checklist (what to do during pilot):
- Confirm dataset residency and sample request/response size distribution.
- Capture 95th and 99th latency targets for the UI path.
- Instrument 10 representative prompts for quality regression checks.
- Turn on prefix KV cache for repeated workflows.
- Run Optimize suggestion report after 48–72hrs of traffic.
- Schedule canary: 5% traffic to Dedicated or alternative variant for 72hrs.

Objection handling (one-liners):
- "We need on-prem": "We support Private with customer-controlled control plane; migration path from hosted is straightforward with the same API surface."
- "Dedicated is expensive": "Reserved capacity reduces per-token cost for sustained workloads; we can start hosted and flip to Dedicated when committed qps emerges."
- "How do we avoid regressions": "We bundle eval harnesses and regression alerts tied to prompt sets — we can ship seed prompt suite during pilot."

Escalation and ops contacts (playbook):
- If pilot needs SLA exception / legal review -> loop in GTM-legal + Solutions Eng (tag: legal-oncall).
- Performance incident during pilot -> SRE oncall (link to runbook id in linked_artifacts).

Snippets sellers can paste into email or Slack (short):
- Quick Slack: "Hi <Eng>, can we run a 2-week pilot? We'll provision a hosted route with KV caching + optimize checks; if 95th latency exceeds target we can kick a canary to Dedicated. Need sample traffic and 3 example prompts."
- Short email subject: "Pilot: Redwood inference – fast onramp + canary plan"

Metrics to commit for pilot success (KPIs):
- 95th latency <= target (customer defined).
- Per-token cost delta vs baseline <= 20% for first-month projection.
- Quality regression rate (prompt-set) <= 5% false-positive change.
- Successful canary handoff without functional regressions.

Notes to self / todo for next iteration:
- Add a one-slide visualization (matrix with icons) for sales deck.
- Create canned Optimize report export for pilots.
- Add legal short-checklist for PCI/PHI flows.
- Collect two customer pilot anecdotes to seal narrative.

References & links: (informal)
- Confluence pilot template: CONFLUENCE-4521
- Demo repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/demo-pilots
- Runbook: JIRA-2897

End of sketch — intended as pocket cheat for sellers running fast technical pilots.
(If useful, I can convert this to a two-slide printable PDF and a Slack snippet pack.)
